about:
Pak Solutions operates from Lancaster, New Hampshire, at 16 Page Hill Road. The company came under new ownership in June 2018 when a group of New England–based investors acquired it; the founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The firm manufactures tamper-evident packaging products including security deposit bags, STEB duty-free bags, vault bags, patient valuables bags, and glue-seal evidence bags. It also supplies medical, food, e-commerce, and specialty packaging. Production capabilities center on flexographic solvent printing and laminating, supported by an in-house graphics department and two flexo solvent presses, one a 2020 Koenig & Bauer unit. A $7 million equipment expansion was completed in 2020. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span healthcare facilities requiring sterile packaging, airlines and duty-free retailers using ICAO-compliant STEB bags, security and law-enforcement agencies needing evidence bags, food processors, and online retailers. The company positions itself as a one-stop supplier for packaging supplies and equipment across these segments.

Pak Solutions differentiates itself as an approved manufacturer of STEB bags under International Civil Aviation Organization guidelines. The in-house graphics team enables quick turnaround on custom printing, and the 2020 capital investment underscores a focus on modernizing production capacity.
